Description.TranslatedText: Relative day: date - TRTSDT + 1 if date >= TRTSDT, else date - TRTSDT. Null if either is null.
Running number within USUBJID, ordered PARAMN, then time point or visit.
SRCDOM, SRCVAR, SRCSEQ point to the IS record the value comes from.
AGE <= 45: '18-45' (AGEGR1N 1); AGE >= 46: '46-60' (2). Matches the randomization stratum.
TRT01P = DM.ARM, TRT01A = DM.ACTARM. TRT01PN, TRT01AN: VAXF-101 1, Placebo 2. Null for screen failures; TRT01A also null for the 2 randomized subjects not dosed.
Date part of DS.DSSTDTC where DS.DSDECOD = RANDOMIZED.
TRTSDTM = DM.RFXSTDTC as datetime, TRTSDT = its date part. TRTEDT = date part of DM.RFXENDTC. Single dose, so TRTEDT = TRTSDT. Null if not dosed.

From the DS record with DSCAT = DISPOSITION EVENT (one per subject). EOSSTT = COMPLETED if DSDECOD = COMPLETED, else DISCONTINUED. EOSDT = date part of DSSTDTC. DCSREAS = DSDECOD when EOSSTT = DISCONTINUED. Screen failures: DISCONTINUED, SCREEN FAILURE.
'Y' if a DS record with DSDECOD = RANDOMIZED exists, else 'N'.
'Y' if RANDFL = 'Y' and the subject has an EX record (TRTSDT not null), else 'N'.
'Y' if SAFFL = 'Y' and all three strains have a valid HAI result (ISSTAT null) at Day 1 and Day 22, and the Day 22 sample is within window (study day 19 to 25, TRTSDT = day 1). Otherwise 'N'.
ISBDAGNT STRAIN A/B/C -> PARAMCD HAIA/HAIB/HAIC, PARAMN 1/2/3. PARAM per codelist PARAMIS.
AVALC = IS.ISSTRESC. AVAL = IS.ISSTRESN; if ISSTRESC = '<10', AVAL = LLOQ / 2 = 5. Null if ISSTAT = NOT DONE.
ADT = date part of IS.ISDTC. AVISIT = IS.VISIT, AVISITN = IS.VISITNUM.

ABLFL = 'Y' on the Day 1 record where IS.ISLOBXFL = 'Y' and AVAL is not null. BASE, BASEC = AVAL, AVALC of that record, carried to every record of the same subject and PARAMCD. BASECAT1 = '<10' if BASEC = '<10', else '>=10'.
AVAL / BASE on Day 22 records. Null on Day 1 records or if AVAL or BASE is null.
CRIT1FL = 'Y' if AVAL >= 40, 'N' if AVAL < 40, null if AVAL is null. Day 1 and Day 22.

Day 22 only. Seroconversion: BASECAT1 = '<10' and AVAL >= 40, or BASECAT1 = '>=10' and R2BASE >= 4. CRIT2FL = 'Y' if met, 'N' if not, null if AVAL or BASE is null. CRIT2 and CRIT2FL are null on Day 1.
'Y' if IMMFL = 'Y' and AVAL is not null.
One parameter per reaction: PARAMCD = reaction (codelist PARAMFA), PARCAT1 = LOCAL or SYSTEMIC. Local: pain, tenderness, redness, swelling, induration. Systemic: fever and the other 7.

Reactions other than fever, per FA.FAOBJ and FATPT. Redness, swelling, induration: MEASVAL = FA DIAMETER FASTRESN (mm), AVAL = 0 if < 25, 1 if 25-50, 2 if 51-100, 3 if > 100. Pain, tenderness, chills, malaise, myalgia, headache, arthralgia, nausea, vomiting: AVAL = 0 if FA OCCUR = N, else 1/2/3 for FA SEV = MILD/MODERATE/SEVERE; MEASVAL null. Fever (VS TEMP, VSCAT = REACTOGENICITY, VSSTRESN in C): MEASVAL = VSSTRESN, AVAL = 0 if < 38.0, 1 if 38.0-38.4, 2 if 38.5-38.9, 3 if 39.0-40.0, 4 if > 40.0. MEASU = mm or C.
FA.FATPT, VS.VSTPT -> ATPT (30 MINUTES POST-DOSE, DAY 1-DAY 7), ATPTN 0-7. ADT = date part of FADTC or VSDTC.

SRCDOM FA or VS. SRCVAR and SRCSEQ point to the record that gives AVAL: FA DIAMETER (FASTRESN) for diameter reactions; FA SEV (FASTRESC) when FA OCCUR = Y, else the OCCUR record, for the others; VS (VSSTRESN) for fever.
CEOCCUR = N: ATOXGR '0'. Else CETOXGR if not null (diameter and temperature reactions), else CESEV MILD/MODERATE/SEVERE -> '1'/'2'/'3'. ATOXGRN = numeric ATOXGR.
CETPT '30 MINUTES POST-DOSE' -> ATPT the same, ATPTN 0. CETPT 'DAY 7' -> ATPT 'WITHIN 7 DAYS POST-DOSE', ATPTN 8.
ASTDT, AENDT = date part of CESTDTC, CEENDTC. Null when no reaction.

Among records with CEOCCUR = Y, within USUBJID and ATPTN, ordered by ATOXGRN descending then CESEQ: AOCCFL = 'Y' on the first record; AOCCSFL on the first within CESCAT; AOCCPFL on every such record (one per reaction). Null otherwise. The flagged record carries the maximum grade.

AENDT = date part of AEENDTC. ASTDT = date part of AESTDTC. If AESTDTC is year-month only: ASTDT = TRTSDT when it falls in the same month, else the first day of that month; ASTDTF = 'D'. Otherwise ASTDTF is null.
'Y' if ASTDT >= TRTSDT, else null. Null if ASTDT or TRTSDT is null.
ANL01FL = 'Y' if AECAT = UNSOLICITED, TRTEMFL = 'Y' and ASTDY <= 22. ANL02FL = 'Y' if AESER = 'Y' and TRTEMFL = 'Y' and ASTDY <= 91.
Among records with TRTEMFL = 'Y', within USUBJID: AOCCFL = 'Y' on the first record by ASTDT, AESEQ; AOCCSFL on the first within AEBODSYS; AOCCPFL on the first within AEBODSYS and AEDECOD.
ADSL has all 267 screened subjects, including 27 screen failures (RANDFL = N). Populations: safety = randomized and dosed (238); immunogenicity per protocol = IMMFL.
Single 0.5 mL dose on Day 1, so TRTEDT = TRTSDT.
Window and valid-result rules follow docs/study-design.md (Day 22 +/- 3 days).

HAI titers are reciprocal dilutions. Results below LLOQ (10) are reported '<10' and enter GMT, GMFR and seroconversion as LLOQ / 2 = 5. AVALC keeps the reported text. GMT is computed in the TLF program as exp(mean(ln AVAL)).

FDA 2007 toxicity grading scale for preventive vaccine trials. Grade 4 is possible only for fever (> 40.0 C); the other reactions have no ER-visit or necrosis data, so they stop at 3. Missing diary days have no record; no imputation.
MEASVAL is diameter (mm) for redness, swelling, induration and temperature (C) for fever. Null for severity-scale reactions.
SDTM CE holds one summary record per reaction per window. ADCE restates the grade from CE. Cross-check: ATOXGRN equals the maximum ADFACE AVAL for the same reaction and window (30 minutes; Day 1-7).
Unsolicited AEs are counted through Day 22 (ANL01FL), SAEs through Day 91 (ANL02FL).
No MedDRA. AEDECOD and AEBODSYS are carried from SDTM, which uses a local coding table.
